recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If Pharmacy later reopens R6 DosageDetails free-text behavior, review the guidance on DosageDetails.renderedInstruction rather than adding MedicationStatement.note prose.
issue_request: FHIR-8014 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Pharmacy request asking where a free-text SIG belongs on MedicationStatement, with proposed guidance near MedicationStatement.note. The accepted resolution said Dosage.text was the appropriate field and requested a short/definition describing reported free-text dosage information for human display even when coded dosage information is present.
initial_application: Git commit 8926d3f854ca89a48d4ddec52559c160f94ec710 applied the issue by changing MedicationStatement.dosage.text in the legacy MedicationStatement spreadsheet to the requested short label and definition. Later dosage work consolidated this field into reusable dosage datatypes.
additional_context: MedicationStatement, Dosage, and DosageDetails are active build inputs in source/fhir.ini. In current source, MedicationStatement.dosage is typed as DosageDetails rather than having an in-resource MedicationStatement.dosage.text child. Applied R6 issue FHIR-54014 made DosageDetails.renderedInstruction 1..1 and gave it full dosage intent wording, so the current datatype location preserves the substance of the original free-text SIG decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Adding MedicationStatement.note-specific guidance would be redundant and potentially misleading because current source already provides the free-text dosage representation through the authoritative dosage datatype.
